Definition: a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth)
BiblicalUsage: The curse speaks of the young one that comes out in the siege, when there is nothing left to eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hardest verse in the curses is the one about the child, and it shows what siege does to a people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
